name: segmentpay
description: SegmentPay — Multi-Segment Wallet with Multi-Payment per Order (PWA demo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --workspace @segmentpay/api run dev" "npm --workspace @segmentpay/web run dev"
scripts.build: npm --workspace @segmentpay/shared run build && npm --workspace @segmentpay/api run build && npm --workspace @segmentpay/web run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace @segmentpay/shared run build && npm --workspace @segmentpay/api run typecheck && npm --workspace @segmentpay/web run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace @segmentpay/shared run build && npm --workspace @segmentpay/api run test
scripts.qa:boot: concurrently -k -s first -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm --workspace @segmentpay/api run start" "npm --workspace @segmentpay/web run preview -- --port 5173 --host 127.0.0.1"
